description: List purchasable plans for a destination, cheapest first. type "data" = data-only eSIM: validity starts on first connection at the destination. type "number" = eSIM with a phone number, calls and SMS: validity starts at installation, so install it just before use; Europe plans give a French +33 number; the UK number plan must be installed only after arrival in the UK. For a country without its own plans, regional and world plans that cover it are returned. Prices are final USD prices; the crypto amount is set at create_order.

destination.description: Destination code from search_destinations, or a country ISO2 code

include_regional.description: For a country: also return regional/world plans covering it

name: list_plans
title: List plans
